answer: Tie every agent to an accountable operator with a zero-knowledge credential: a licensed issuer checks a real business or person once, then the operator proves membership privately and each epoch derives one nullifier per agent slot, capped at five. A gale of fresh accounts from one operator reuses nullifiers and is rejected. A thousand independent agents becomes a fable unless the attacker buys 200 verified, legally traceable identities, and a ring caught colluding drains away like water into karst, losing every credential at once.
